observation: Architecture critique caught CRITICAL gap before code: session-lifecycle.ts independently hard-imports both assembleContext + startWatcher (second call-site plan missed). Critique surfaced it before red phase, enabling single design revision to fold the gap into call-site table and decouple tasks. Cost averted: ~3-4h code/test rework + re-review. Pattern: AK-track /architecture-critique consistently catches load-bearing oversights.

Empirical boundary analysis (read actual code, find call sites) is correct method. Plan correctly identified that composed prompt is built only from Kernel-owned data (system prompt, tools, DB rows); knowledge reaches agent as files in sandbox, not embedded. This narrow scope (two operations: assemble-in, ingest-out) makes Fabric trivially satisfiable. Zero behaviour change achieved via proper analysis, not luck.

TDD red phase caught vacuity early. Red-phase tests wrote both happy-path and failure-path assertions. Green-phase tests revealed AD2 dispatcher's failure path wasn't exercised (test passed vacuously when registry unset). Fix-pass registered Strategy in AD2 test blocks + added dedicated AC3 parity test. Failure mode avoided: silent pass of tests claiming to verify unexercised behaviour.

Generic type parameter resolved dependency cycle cleanly. Plan flagged hard question: strategy-port in shared but needs HyperIdleDb type from db (cycle: shared→db, db→shared). Builder parameterized request types: ContextAssemblyRequest<TDb>. Keeps shared db-agnostic; concrete binding at composition root. Zero runtime impact. Reusable pattern for architecture cycles.

Stale-base hazard mid-pipeline (critical timeline impact). AK2 branched from #287/AJ1 merge (added design-system code). During run, origin/main reverted that code. Branch carried dead code; rebase check (Phase 3) only does 'merge origin/main', didn't catch divergence until merge-conflict time. Diagnosis cost ~2h. Phase-3 rebase check should detect when base commit reverted on main, not masked until merge.

Vacuous tests discovered in review phase, not during green. AD2 dispatcher test passed because registry unset, causing happy-path test to assert on inertness guarded by fs.existsSync after sandbox cleanup. Builder ran tests, saw green. Review caught independently. Pattern: builders not validating full failure/happy-path matrix in harness before declaring green. Recommendation: pre-green checkpoint validates 'all red-phase test failure paths exercised with harness fully set up'.

Process overhead: stale attestations after main merge. Full merge of origin/main (Phase 3→Phase 4) left attestations scoped to old base. /ship flagged these as needing re-signing. Builder manually deleted old attestations + re-ran verify. Cost: ~30min orchestration overhead + 2 agent turns on 'fix attestation state' vs verification logic. Should auto-clean: attestations scoped to previous base commits deleted as /ship pre-check.

Architecture critique value on AK track is high. Missing call-site gap (session-lifecycle.ts) parallels AK1 gap (same pattern: empirical boundary missed second call path). Systemic issue: 'find all callers' via grep patterns missing files or incomplete function names. Recommendation: /architecture should end with grep -r 'symbol-name' packages/server/src/ to verify call-site census exhaustive, not inspection-only.

Stale-base detection weak in pipeline. Phase-3 rebase check only 'merge origin/main'; doesn't check 'git merge-base --is-ancestor <base> origin/main'. This masked #287 revert until merge-conflict time. Recommendation: add gate checking base still exists on main before merge-and-verify. Cost <30s per run; huge signal value. Stale-base hazard recurring (AK1, AK2, pattern).

Cost breakdown: productive work ~6h (concept 0.5h + critique 0.5h + red 1h + green 2h + review 1h + fix 0.5h + docs 0.5h); infrastructure overhead ~3h (stale-base diagnosis 2h + attestation churn 0.5h + main-merge conflicts 0.5h) = 33% overhead cost. Mirrors U6, AK1 pattern: 30-50% duration consumed by infrastructure (attestation loops, stale bases, CI sync) vs domain work. Signal: infrastructure cost pattern recurring ≥3 recent runs; worth /compound attention.
